note: Small Murray County park (also called Avoca County Park) on the south side of Lime Lake just west of Avoca, off paved County Road 6. Three pads on the edge of a gravel loop, beside a boat landing, dock, picnic shelter and restrooms. --Claude
summary: County page + 2024 county site map read: 3 sites, $25 night ($15 tent), first come with pay envelope or online bill pay, no reservations. Lakeview kept after the hard check: pads 1-3 face a continuous shoreline tree belt 25-35 m from the water; the only open ground to the shore is the boat landing. Phone added. Electric not confirmed by the county (left as stored, not written).
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview kept (hard check): the county map marks sites 1-3 as pads on the west edge of the gravel loop (about 43.9455,-95.6626). On Esri imagery (0.24 m/px) a continuous belt of shoreline trees stands between them and Lime Lake, the water 25-35 m away; the open sand that reaches the shore is the boat landing and dock apron, which cannot carry the value. View, not front.
PHONE: none stored; Murray County Parks 'For camping information contact ... Murray County Parks at 507-836-1195 or 507-227-3925'. Suggest 507-836-1195.

ELECTRIC unconfirmed: the stored note says 'Three camping pads with electricity'; the county page lists only 'Boat Landing, Dock, Picnic Shelter, Restroom Facilities, 3 Campsites' and the map shows no pedestals at this scale. Dropped from the note; no hookups written.
SEASON not posted for overnight sites (the page's 'May 1 – October 1' applies to seasonal contracts, which Lime Lake does not offer). Nothing written.
